research_metadata.coverage_notes: Solukhumbu is a remote Himalayan district in Koshi Province, Nepal. Higher education institutions are scarce, with Solukhumbu Multiple Campus being the primary prominent constituent/community campus affiliated with Tribhuvan University in the district. Other smaller campuses or +2 schools offering higher education are extremely limited or function primarily under school structures.

identity.name: Solukhumbu Multiple Campus
identity.short_description: Solukhumbu Multiple Campus is a community-based campus located in the Solukhumbu district of Koshi Province, affiliated with Tribhuvan University.
identity.description: Solukhumbu Multiple Campus serves as a vital center for higher education in the remote Himalayan district of Solukhumbu. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University, it offers undergraduate programs primarily in Humanities, Education, and Management streams, providing accessible higher education to local students who might otherwise need to travel to Kathmandu or Biratnagar.
